title: Ticket key intake
prompt: Write src/duplicate-keys.mjs as an ES module that exports mapKeys(items, startAt). items is an array of ticket objects shaped like { key }, and startAt is the integer number the first id uses. mapKeys returns { ids, errors }: ids is a Map from each accepted key to its id, and errors is an array of human-readable strings. An id has the form T- followed by a four-digit number, zero-padded, counting up from startAt in item order, and only accepted items use a number. A key that is not a non-empty string gets an error and no id, and a key that has already been used in this call also gets an error and no id, while the first use keeps its id. Keys such as __proto__ and constructor are ordinary keys and must work like any other string. Do not change any other file.
